summary: MARA Holdings' subsidiary Volt Texas amended its July 2, 2026 membership interest purchase agreement with HIF USA for MAT 1177 LLC, which holds Texas land and rights to 2,000 MW of power capacity. The September 21, 2026 first amendment posted a $100 million security deposit with the electric utility, restructured milestone payments tied to regulatory approvals into two installments, and revised project milestones. Consideration remains post-closing milestone-based, with no per-share price stated. Watch Texas regulatory audit outcomes, milestone timing, and whether MARA draws the refundable deposit, affecting deal economics.
